dict.string: TurnOver asks VoiceOver to say a few words where VoiceOver is reading, asks Microsoft Word for the page and line number, and asks Keynote for the words of the slide showing while a presentation plays.
TurnOver keeps VoiceOver's sound quiet while TurnOver reads, so the two never speak at once. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent.
TurnOver connects to your Bluetooth braille display, as VoiceOver does.

TurnOver listens for the VoiceOver keys in the apps it reads, so it can read and move around for you.
